name: tsl-view-geometry-varyings
adaptedFrom: original — the fragment varyings three r185 builds for positionViewDirection (positionView.negate().toVarying()), normalWorldGeometry (normalViewGeometry back through the view matrix, i.e. modelNormalMatrix * normalLocal, as a varying) and depth (viewZToPerspectiveDepth(positionView.z)): a sphere coloured by the view direction, a rotated box and a non-uniformly scaled sphere (where only the inverse transpose keeps normals perpendicular) by their world geometry normals, a normal-mapped standard plane whose emissive is normalWorldGeometry (the map does not reach it), and a tilted plane shaded by depth
